BETA Close X Centrica PLC has announced the purchase of 1,121,853 ordinary shares on January 5, 2026, at an average price of 172.9334 pence per share, as part of its ongoing buyback program. This transaction brings the total number of shares repurchased since September 22, 2025, to 143,456,659, costing £243,698,978.28. Following this purchase, Centrica now holds 456,556,029 ordinary shares in treasury, with 4,608,346,935 shares remaining in issue. Disclaimer* Centrica PLC 06 January 2026 Transactions in own shares Centrica plc 6 January 2026 Centrica plc announces that it purchased on 5 January 2026 (through J.P. Morgan Securities plc JPM) 1,121,853 Centrica plc ordinary shares of 6 14 / 81 pence each at a price of 172.9334 pence per share. The purchased shares will be held as treasury shares. Such purchase was effected pursuant to the second tranche of the Company's buyback programme announced on 22 September 2025 and in accordance with the non-discretionary share repurchase agreement entered into with JPM as also announced on 22 September 2025. Since 22 September 2025, Centrica has purchased 143,456,659 ordinary shares at a cost (excluding dealing and associated costs) of £243,698,978.28. Following the above purchase, Centrica plc holds 456,556,029 ordinary shares in treasury, and has 4,608,346,935 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 (the Market Abuse Regulation) (as in force in the UK and as amended by the Market Abuse (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019), detailed information about the individual purchases made by JPM is set out below.
